sentence: PDE5 inhibitors are medicines that include sildenafil and tadalafil, used mainly for erection problems.
note: NHS Common questions names the group; NHS tadalafil page gives the use.

sentence: Some are also used for pulmonary hypertension.
The NHS warns against combining them with nitrates and poppers because blood pressure can fall sharply.
note: NHS interactions page and tadalafil page.

sentence: StatPearls says these drugs act on the PDE5 enzyme in the smooth muscle of blood vessels and stop it breaking down cGMP.
A review adds that the resulting build-up of cGMP relaxes smooth muscle and increases blood flow.
Nitrates raise cGMP production while PDE5 inhibitors slow its breakdown, so together they can cause a large fall in blood pressure.
note: StatPearls and PMC review, as summarised; blended.

sentence: Headache, indigestion, dizziness and a blocked nose are among the side effects the NHS lists for sildenafil and tadalafil.
A painful or prolonged erection and sudden changes in sight or hearing are listed as serious.
note: NHS side-effects page and tadalafil page.

sentence: StatPearls calls the combination with nitrates absolutely contraindicated.
The NHS lists poppers and some recreational drugs as raising the risk of serious side effects.
Recent heart attack or stroke, low blood pressure and serious heart or liver problems are among the reasons the NHS lists against use.
Combining a PDE5 inhibitor with nitrates can cause a dangerous fall in blood pressure.
Sudden loss of vision or hearing needs a call to a doctor right away.
A dangerous fall in blood pressure; the NHS says PDE5 inhibitors are not usually prescribed with nitrates.
A dangerous effect on the heart, or a higher risk of serious side effects.
The NHS flags a higher risk of serious side effects.

note: Kent and Medway formulary names sildenafil, tadalafil and vardenafil; the PMC review lists avanafil among PDE5 inhibitors.
